title: Using AI to buy and sell a house in Copenhagen
description: I treated selling and buying a house as a work project. What AI actually did: read every tilstandsrapport, query Denmark's public registers directly, and score every house the same way so one shiny feature could not win.

1: Terminal output of triage_address.py scoring a Copenhagen address: commute, motorway distance, air quality and soil contamination pulled from free public registers
2: Diagram showing houses moving through folders — inbox, _new, _consideration, _viewed, then _offered or _rejected — as the whole database
3: Diagram of a Danish tilstandsrapport condition report turned by AILANG parse into a 30-second summary that flags a leased fjernvarme unit for the lawyer
